# Whisper in Blackwater House

Synthetic scenario fixture for regression testing. No published material is reproduced here.

## Premise

A missing antiquarian vanished after cataloguing a salt-stained ledger recovered from a drained marsh.

## Key Locations

Blackwater House sits over a collapsed smugglers' chapel where voices return a few seconds too late.

## Notable NPCs

- Edith Vale, the last surviving heir, wants the investigators gone before the house names her next.
- Inspector Croft believes the case is smuggling until the walls begin answering direct questions.

## Clues

- The ledger lists tides on nights when the marsh should have been dry.
- Chapel stones carry soot from candles burned decades after the room was sealed.
- Edith's family portraits show one face gradually fading from each generation.
